  | description              = This magnificent bastard sword appears to somehow have been made from a ray of solidified light. It is nearly weightless, and despite its size, is able to be wielded effectively by anyone who is proficient in the use of short swords. Rumor and hushed whispers tell of three sunblades among the Stars of Day that stand out from their brethren, feared by all that hide in shadow and darkness. This blade is Celestia, the Brightest Star of Day.
  | tips                     = 
This weapon has no physical damage component listed; instead, it is a weapon of pure light. This means the weapon ignores all damage reduction as this only applies to physical damage.

Like the [[Sun Blade]], '''Celestia''' is typed as a Short Sword therefore will benefit from the [[Improved Critical| Improved Critical - Piercing]] Feat.

Its damage is increased against mobs that have been rendered vulnerable to light (such as [[Angel of Vengeance]] Shield of Condemnation), or are inherently vulnerable to light damage ([[Monster Champion#Shadow Marked|Shadow Marked Monster Champions]] and many [[Undead]]). It should not, however, be used against [[Will-o'-Wisp]]s or [[Golem race|Golems]] which are resistant to light.

When wielded alone (or with a shield or Rune Arm), Celestia may cause [[Strikethrough]] if you are proficient with Bastard Swords or meet certain other requirements such as taking the [[Two-Handed Fighting]] feat.
